info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Details-v1-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Details API provides access to detailed information about various pets available for adoption. This endpoint enables users to retrieve comprehensive data regarding individual pets, such as their characteristics, availability status, and adoption requirements. It serves as a vital resource for potential adopters looking to find detailed insights into the pets they may wish to adopt. Typical consumers include animal shelters, adoption agencies, and pet adoption platforms, facilitating a smoother adoption process for prospective pet owners.

get.summary: Retrieve detailed information about a specific pet.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch comprehensive details regarding a specific pet by its ID. The response contains all relevant data, including breed, age, and health status.
